claims.statement: On September 24, the attorney general announced an investigation into hundreds of Texas data-center developments over missing TWDB water-use survey responses.
claims.text: On September 24, the attorney general announced an investigation into hundreds of Texas data-center developments over missing TWDB water-use survey responses.
claims.quote: September 24, 2026 | Press Release. Attorney General Ken Paxton is investigating Texas data center developments that have not provided a response to the Texas Water Development Board’s (“TWDB”) water use survey. My office is currently investigating hundreds of data center developments
claims.scope_note: The release names 18 counties but no operator, measured site volume, completed penalty or adjudicated violation.

claims.statement: The online TWDB water-use survey portal closed July 1, 2026, and TWDB accepts past-due PDF forms.
claims.text: The online TWDB water-use survey portal closed July 1, 2026, and TWDB accepts past-due PDF forms.
claims.quote: The Online Water Use Survey application closed July 1, 2026. If you would like to submit a past-due survey, please use a PDF form and email the complete survey to the Water Use Survey Team.
claims.scope_note: This is a route for a late response, not proof that any investigated site has filed.

claims.statement: The 2025 TWDB Industrial Water Use Survey form requests sources and volumes in gallons; groundwater, surface and purchased sources carry monthly rows and metered-or-estimated fields, while reuse is a separate annual field.
claims.text: The 2025 TWDB Industrial Water Use Survey form requests sources and volumes in gallons; groundwater, surface and purchased sources carry monthly rows and metered-or-estimated fields, while reuse is a separate annual field.
claims.quote: INDUSTRIAL Water Use Survey for Calendar Year 2025. Pumped Groundwater (Self-Supplied). Surface Water under a TCEQ Water Right (Self-Supplied). Purchased Water. Volume of Water Intake in Gallons. January February March April May June July August September October November December. Metered or Estimated.
claims.value_text: aquifer surface supplier reuse monthly gallons metered estimated
claims.scope_note: The blank sample form illustrates reporting fields. It is not evidence that a named development received or returned this exact form.

claims.statement: TWDB says the annual Water Use Survey supports regional and state water planning.
claims.text: TWDB says the annual Water Use Survey supports regional and state water planning.
claims.quote: The annual Water Use Survey was created to collect annual data of water use in Texas to support this directive for state and regional water planning, modeling, and resource management.
claims.value_text: survey supports state and regional water planning
claims.scope_note: A missing response limits respondent-specific survey data; it is not proof that planners have no estimates or that use is zero.

claims.statement: The Governor’s office says TWDB must give an initial enforcement progress update by October 14, 2026.
claims.text: The Governor’s office says TWDB must give an initial enforcement progress update by October 14, 2026.
claims.quote: TWDB shall update the Office of the Governor by October 14, 2026, on the progress of its enforcement activities, with further updates thereafter, including when the audit is complete.
claims.scope_note: This is an update date for TWDB, not a data-center survey filing deadline or proof of completed enforcement.

rejected: No site-level water volume, violation finding, or completed penalty appears in the announcement.
A blank state form is a sample, not a submitted form from any investigated development.
The separate ERCOT information request has a distinct deadline and is not merged with the annual TWDB form.
